Payroll Register

What it does
- Shows payroll runs and employee-level payroll totals for a selected company and pay date range.
- Helps payroll administrators review gross wages, employee taxes, employer taxes, deductions, and net pay across payroll runs.
- Supports export to CSV for offline review and reconciliation.

Who can use it
- Payroll administrators and finance users with access to payroll reports.

How to use it
1. Open the Payroll Register page from the main menu.
2. Select a company or leave the company selector set to All companies.
3. Choose a pay date start and end date.
4. Click Refresh to update the report.
5. Click Export CSV to download the report as a CSV file.

Required permissions
- Read access to company and payroll run data.

Common errors
- No results returned: check the pay date range and selected company.
- Empty report: verify that payroll runs exist for the selected company and pay dates.

Troubleshooting
- Confirm the company is active and has payroll runs.
- Confirm the pay date range covers payroll run pay dates.
- If the report still shows no data, check that payroll run records were calculated and not deleted.

Payroll/security cautions
- This report does not show full SSNs or bank account numbers.
- Only last-period payroll totals are displayed.
